# Test Suite (Table) — _studio_demo | ID | Title | Priority | Preconditions | Steps | Expected | |----|-------|----------|---------------|-------|----------| | TC-001 | Add two positive numbers returns correct sum | High | The module _studio_demo is available and initialized | 1. Open the module _studio_demo
2. Call the function add with arguments 2 and 3 | The result should be 5 | | TC-002 | Add two negative numbers returns correct sum | High | The module _studio_demo is available and initialized | 1. Open the module _studio_demo
2. Call the function add with arguments -2 and -3 | The result should be -5 | | TC-003 | Add zero and a positive number returns that positive number | High | The module _studio_demo is available and initialized | 1. Open the module _studio_demo
2. Call the function add with arguments 0 and 5 | The result should be 5 | | TC-004 | Add two large numbers returns correct sum | High | The module _studio_demo is available and initialized | 1. Open the module _studio_demo
2. Call the function add with arguments 1000 and 2000 | The result should be 3000 | | TC-005 | Divide by zero raises ValueError | High | The module _studio_demo is available and initialized | 1. Open the module _studio_demo
2. Call the function divide with arguments 5 and 0 | A ValueError should be raised with message 'cannot divide by zero' | | TC-006 | Divide two positive numbers returns correct result | High | The module _studio_demo is available and initialized | 1. Open the module _studio_demo
2. Call the function divide with arguments 10 and 2 | The result should be 5.0 | | TC-007 | Divide two negative numbers returns correct result | High | The module _studio_demo is available and initialized | 1. Open the module _studio_demo
2. Call the function divide with arguments -10 and -2 | The result should be 5.0 | | TC-008 | Divide a positive number by a large positive number returns correct result | High | The module _studio_demo is available and initialized | 1. Open the module _studio_demo
2. Call the function divide with arguments 100 and 20 | The result should be 5.0 |
